story.title: Conviction in Terrorism Trial for 2022 Stabbing of Salman Rushdie
story.summary: A man has been convicted of federal terrorism charges related to the 2022 stabbing of author Salman Rushdie, who was severely injured in the attack. The conviction adds to the existing 25-year prison sentence the attacker is already serving. The jury found that the attack was motivated by a fatwa issued against Rushdie over his novel 'The Satanic Verses.'

explore_lenses.label: How did the federal case differ from the state case?
explore_lenses.title: A terrorism finding beyond attempted murder
explore_lenses.summary: The New York state case established responsibility for the stabbing itself; the federal case added terrorism-related findings tied to the alleged purpose and organizational context of the attack.

claims.text: Matar was already serving a 25-year New York state sentence for attempted murder arising from the August 2022 attack before the federal verdict.
The federal indictment charged three distinct offenses: attempting to provide material support to Hizballah, providing material support to terrorists, and terrorism transcending national boundaries.

The federal conviction carries a potential life sentence, but the reporting reviewed did not identify a sentencing date or say whether any federal term would run consecutively to, or concurrently with, the state sentence.

explore_lenses.label: What evidence connected the attack to the fatwa?
explore_lenses.title: Messages and alleged Hizballah support
explore_lenses.summary: Prosecutors presented the stabbing as an attempt to act on the 1989 fatwa against Rushdie, relying on Matar's messages, writings and alleged expressions of support for Hizballah.

claims.text: According to exhibits described by AP, Matar discussed the fatwa with messaging-app contacts in 2021 and 2022, expressed anger that Rushdie had insulted Islam, and referred to a 2006 statement by Hizballah leader Hassan Nasrallah.
Federal prosecutors said Matar's communications showed that he located Rushdie's public appearances and identified the August 2022 Chautauqua Institution event before the attack.
The Justice Department's case was that Matar sought to provide himself and his services to Hizballah by carrying out a fatwa he understood the group to have endorsed.
Defense lawyer Nathaniel Barone argued that the government had not proved Matar's state of mind; Matar did not testify.

explore_lenses.label: What is known about Iran's role, if any?
explore_lenses.title: A longstanding threat, not a proven operation
explore_lenses.summary: The attack occurred in the shadow of Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini's 1989 fatwa over The Satanic Verses, but the evidence described publicly separates that longstanding incitement from proof of direct state involvement in the 2022 assault.

claims.text: Khomeini issued the fatwa calling for Rushdie's death in 1989; AP reports it was never rescinded and that an Iranian foundation has offered a bounty of more than $3 million.
After the federal verdict, Assistant Attorney General for National Security John Eisenberg characterized the attack as evidence of the global reach of Iranian terrorism.
Iran's government has denied involvement in the attack.

related_stories.title: Ceuta Requests National Emergency Amid Surge of Migrants from Morocco
related_stories.summary: Authorities in Ceuta have requested Spain to declare a national emergency due to a significant influx of migrants swimming from Morocco. The local government is seeking military assistance as border security is overwhelmed by the number of individuals attempting to enter the territory.

related_stories.title: Iran Promises Retaliation After US Conducts Major Strikes in Response to Attacks
related_stories.summary: Iran has vowed to retaliate against the United States following a significant military response from the US, which included a 'heavy wave of strikes' targeting Iranian positions. This action was taken in retaliation for Iran's missile attack on US forces stationed in Jordan. The strikes mark a resurgence in hostilities in the region, complicating ongoing peace negotiations and drawing in Iranian proxies.

related_stories.title: US Conducts Strikes on Iranian Targets Following Foiled Missile Attack
related_stories.summary: The US has launched significant strikes on Iranian targets in response to an attempted missile attack on American forces. This escalation follows a brief period of reduced hostilities between the two sides, which have now resumed missile exchanges.

related_stories.title: Russian Strikes Across Ukraine Result in Multiple Casualties
related_stories.summary: Russian strikes across Ukraine have killed at least eight people and injured dozens more, including children. The overnight assault involved over 70 missiles and 280 drones, impacting various regions including the capital, Kyiv, and Poltava. This attack has prompted renewed calls from Ukrainian officials for increased air defense support from allies.
